findings: Owner request 2026-11-09: practice long questions for Chapter 14 in the same format as the Physics 11 chapter practice (English and Roman Urdu), written from the chapter; not printed in the book. 26 questions numbered 1-26; by section: 14.1 2, 14.3 8, 14.4 4, 14.5 2, 14.6 2, 14.7 2, 14.8 2, 14.10 4.

13 pairs (theory 5 marks + numerical 3 marks) covering the terms of oscillatory motion, the mass-spring system (S.H.M proof, then ω, f and T), the simple pendulum, measuring g, S.H.M and uniform circular motion (displacement, velocity, acceleration), phase, the graphs of S.H.M, energy in S.H.M, free/forced/damped oscillations, resonance and its uses, and resonance with standing waves. Numericals use new values, recomputed in Python. Book corrections followed: θ = 2π for one revolution, T = 2π√(m/k), sinθ ≈ θ, angle about 10° or less, v = ω√(x₀² − x²), T.E = ½mω²x₀², phase difference π between a and x, receiver absorbs the energy, tall flames half a wavelength apart.
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
